name: Birth Island Deoxys & Creation Dragons
summary: Conclude the extraterrestrial research on Kin Island by investigating the meteor crater atop Bond Bridge waterfall. Collect the scattered spaceship fragments and take the harbor vessel to Birth Island to solve the triangular obelisk sequence, challenging alien lifeform Deoxys (Lv. 70). Additionally, with Mt. Silver cleared, the spacetime rift has caused the Creation Trio to solidify across the world: use Rock Climb on Boon Island to challenge Dialga (Lv. 75), ascend behind Blackthorn City for Palkia (Lv. 75), and scale the cliffs of Route 4 for Giratina (Lv. 75).

items.name: Adamant Orb
items.method: Found on the elevated rock bluff directly behind Dialga on Boon Island

items.name: Lustrous Orb
items.method: Found on the misty cliff plateau behind Palkia in Blackthorn City

items.name: Griseous Orb
items.method: Found in the shadowy cave opening behind Giratina on Route 4

Special.rate: Boon Island Rock Climb Summit Event
